theorems.name: Submission.lpf_c1_local_antilipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (G : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (w : Eucl n), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G w) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z ∈ ball w r, ∀ z' ∈ ball w r, c * ‖z - z'‖ ≤ ‖G z - G z'‖
